query_prometheus_metric: query prometheus API for a specific metric name over the last 24 hours and return raw results
get_fallback_metrics: get fallback metrics from prometheus for successful and failed deployment fallbacks over the last 24 hours
check_prometheus_connection: check if prometheus is connected by verifying the PROMETHEUS_URL environment variable is set
get_daily_spend: get daily spend data from prometheus for the last 30 days, optionally filtered by api key
run_prometheus_query: run a prometheus query for any metric name and retrieve the result data from the prometheus API
